To get your API key:
1. Sign in to beehiiv.
2. Open **Settings** and select **API** under Workspace Settings.
3. Click **Create New API Key**, name it, and copy the key (it is shown only once).
Update an existing subscription. Fields: Update an existing subscription. Fields you leave empty are not changed.
Permanently deletes a subscription from: Löscht dauerhaft ein Abonnement aus einer Beehiv-Veröffentlichung.
Retrieves subscriptions for a Beehiiv pu: Retrieves subscriptions for a Beehiiv publication. With Limit and Cursor empty it returns every match (up to 5,000); set Limit or Cursor to get one page with a next cursor.
Adds an existing subscription to an auto: Adds an existing subscription to an automation. The automation must have an active "Add by API" trigger.
Retrieves the automations of a publicati: Retrieves the automations of a publication. With Limit and Page empty it returns all of them; otherwise it returns only the requested page.
Retrieves posts of a publication, newest: Retrieves posts of a publication, newest first by default. With Limit and Page empty it returns all matching posts (up to 10,000, or 1,000 when content is expanded); otherwise it returns only the requested page with paging info.
Lists the publications in the connected: Listet die Veröffentlichungen im verbundenen beehiiv-Arbeitsbereich auf.

Triggers when a post is sent or publishe: Triggers when a post is sent or published in the selected publication. Requires a paid beehiiv plan (Lite allows 3 webhooks in total).
Triggers when a subscriber unsubscribes: Triggers when a subscriber unsubscribes or is deleted from the publication (Unsubscribe Source is empty for deletions). Requires a paid beehiiv plan.
Triggers when a new subscriber confirms: Triggers when a new subscriber confirms their subscription. Requires a paid beehiiv plan.
Triggers when a new subscriber is create: Triggers when a new subscriber is created (before email confirmation). Also fires for subscribers added through the API, so a flow that creates subscribers from this trigger can loop. Requires a paid beehiiv plan.
